allowed_claims: finite nontrivial fiber-augmented 33-cell cover exists as a scratch diagnostic object
quotient projection to the committed 33-cell carrier is computed
Axis0 and Axis6 are faithful pullbacks through the quotient projection
Axis3 gamma_in/gamma_out placement is computed natively on pinned finite fiber phases
b6=-b0*b3 is tested only after the nonzero winding witness gate passes

chance_thresholds.panel_sample_unit_note: Panel 9 names N=33 base cells; this table tests N=99 cover states and reports the unit explicitly.

bundle_witness.witness_rule: sum lifted fiber phase transitions around the closed equatorial loop divided by |F|; nontrivial +/-1, trivial 0

panel_anchor_checks.anchor_surface: Hopf panel anchor, not Family A 33-cell row
Hopf panel anchor, not Family A 33-cell row

cover.chart_transition_policy: degree-1 Hopf clutching discretized on the committed equatorial loop; transition shifts are constant along each fiber and sum to one winding
cover.fiber_phase_policy: three pinned directed U(1) sectors; |F|=3 is pinned to carry directed winding rather than parity-only |F|=2

singularity_handling.policy: pole cells are pinned to same-chart/zero transition rows; the witness loop avoids poles and uses accumulated-phase bookkeeping

disallowed_claims: Axis3 placement on the 33-cell quotient without the finite fiber
divergence_log: v1 repairs the v0 wrong-object blocker by requiring a computed nonzero bundle witness before law rows. The law outcome is still a scratch diagnostic result, not admission or bridge evidence.

axis3.realization: native finite-fiber gamma_in/gamma_out predicate classification over three directed sectors
